sourceType.description: What kind of record it cites, e.g. `transcript_entry`.

sourceId.description: The record it cites. `sourceType` says what kind.

path.description:
For a suggestion whose call carries a JSON Patch, the change this
backs up: the `path` of one of the patch's changes, such as
`/incomes/e218…/amount`. Absent, it backs up the whole suggestion.
A path no change in the patch has is refused with `422`.

confidence.description: How sure a model was. Absent for rules and people. For display and review only; nothing in the lifecycle reads it.

metadata.description:
Context from other domains, by the cross-domain pass-through
convention — `intake.interviewId`, say — so everything proposed
during something can be listed together.

expiresAt.description: When it stops applying, if nothing decides it first. One day after it was proposed, when not given.

allOf.description: The id a caller may choose for a record it creates, following JSON:API's client-generated ids. Every create schema references it. Without an id, the server sets one. An id another record already has is refused with 409. Choosing the id lets one request name a record another change in it creates, as a JSON Patch to a composition does.

id.description: The new record's id, a UUID (RFC 9562).

call.description: An operation and its arguments. The operationId is one the contracts declare, as overlays leave them; the arguments are checked against that operation's parameters and request schema. A stored call leaves out the `Idempotency-Key` header even where its operation requires one: a key guards one request, so whatever makes the call supplies it.

parameters.description: The operation's path, query, header and cookie parameters, as an Arazzo step or an OpenAPI operation lists them.

name.description: The parameter's name, as the operation declares it.

requestBody.description: The request body a call sends, as an Arazzo step's requestBody: the body itself in `payload`, and the media type in `contentType` when the operation accepts more than one.

contentType.description: One of the media types the operation's requestBody lists. Defaults to application/json.

payload.description: The request body, in the operation's request schema.
